caption: The drawing depicts a transparent glass mug with a rounded base and a sturdy handle attached to the left side. The mug is adorned with decorative elements, including two horizontal bands near the top and bottom; the upper band consists of red and yellow stripes, while the lower band is predominantly red. Between these bands is a colorful painted design featuring a red sphere, yellow swirls, blue accents, green foliage, and smaller red dots, with additional yellow architectural motifs resembling a small structure with a pointed red roof. The composition centers the mug on a plain, unadorned background with a faint rectangular border. The glass is rendered with light gray and white shading to indicate its reflective and translucent properties. The artist’s name, "JOHN DANA," is written at the bottom right outside the main rectangular frame.
title: Mug
